subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver problemas que envolvam variação de proporcionalidade direta entre duas grandezas, para associar a quantidade de um produto ao valor a pagar, alterar as quantidades de ingredientes de receitas, ampliar ou reduzir escala em mapas, entre outros.

components.description_pt: Determinar se duas quantidades estão em relação de proporcionalidade
components.description_en: Determine whether two quantities are in a proportional relationship
components.cc_component_description: Determine whether two quantities are in a proportional relationship

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo variação proporcional direta para determinar custo total de produto
components.description_en: Solve problems involving direct proportional variation to determine total cost of a product
components.cc_component_description: Solve problems involving finding the whole when given a part and the percent

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo variação proporcional direta para ajustar quantidades em receitas
components.description_en: Solve problems involving direct proportional variation to adjust ingredient quantities in recipes

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo variação proporcional direta para interpretar escala em mapas
components.description_en: Solve problems involving direct proportional variation to interpret scale on maps
components.cc_component_description: Reproduce a scale drawing at a different scale (using proportional reasoning)

components.description_pt: Aplicar o conceito de proporção direta em problemas de ampliação e redução em contexto
components.description_en: Apply the concept of direct proportion to solve enlargement and reduction problems in context
components.cc_component_description: Apply similarity theorems to solve real-world problems

cc_matches.description: Decide whether two quantities are in a proportional relationship, e.g., by testing for equivalent ratios in a table or graphing on a coordinate plane and observing whether the graph is a straight line through the origin.
Find a percent of a quantity as a rate per 100 (e.g., 30% of a quantity means 30/100 times the quantity); solve problems involving finding the whole, given a part and the percent.
Recognize and represent proportional relationships between quantities.
Solve problems involving scale drawings of geometric figures, including computing actual lengths and areas from a scale drawing and reproducing a scale drawing at a different scale.
Use congruence and similarity criteria for triangles to solve problems and to prove relationships in geometric figures.
